release_notes:
FocusShield Engine v1.4.7:
• Today's Study Goal System: Interactive daily target manager (30m, 45m, 60m, 90m presets or custom). Directly editable with real-time progress syncing.
• Live Study Goal Visualizer: Active study screen now displays real-time progress bar towards your daily study goal with achievement celebrations.
• Tactile Micro-Interactions & End Session Dialog: Haptic feedback, smooth animated switches, and confirmation wrap-up modal that records focused minutes directly into your goal.
• Focus Study Mode & YouTube Switch: Clean distraction lock with essential apps allowed (Phone, SMS, Contacts, Clock, Calculator) and YouTube Lecture mode toggle.
